content.title: Kinetic Character Typography | Action Triggers and Poster Return
content.summary: An adult courier turns four route actions into a modular night-line poster. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.

quick_start.input_format: One adult character identity anchors every graphic module. + Each bounded body action visibly precedes one typography response. + Short exact words remain readable and spatially attached to the triggering action. + Detail shots reconnect to the complete character before the next module. + The final lockup reunites character, palette, graphic motif and one exact title.
quick_start.recommended_input: Lock one original adult animated bike courier with silver hair, amber eyes, a navy jacket and coral trousers inside an ivory title grid. One heel pivot triggers a coral ring; one controlled jump breaks the ring into three diagonal panels marked "TURN". Return her to an ivory poster lockup inside the rebuilt ring beneath the exact title "NIGHT LINE".
required_anchors: One adult character identity anchors every graphic module.
Each bounded body action visibly precedes one typography response.
Detail shots reconnect to the complete character before the next module.
The final lockup reunites character, palette, graphic motif and one exact title.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: An adult courier turns four route actions into a modular night-line poster. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.
not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue, or shot order.
Concepts that cannot show all required anchors inside the target duration.
Long-form exposition or unrelated multi-location stories without a compact causal chain.

creative_dna.mechanism: An adult courier turns four route actions into a modular night-line poster. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface. The reusable mechanism retains causal order and evidence duties while replacing source identity, setting, wording, objects, choreography and design.

invariants.rule: One adult character identity anchors every graphic module.
invariants.purpose: Establishes the baseline identity, object or geography that every later state must preserve.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact baseline rule, later changes cannot be attributed to the same subject, object or place, so the sequence loses its reference state. Removed rule: "One adult character identity anchors every graphic module."

invariants.rule: Each bounded body action visibly precedes one typography response.
invariants.purpose: Makes the visible trigger precede and explain the first mechanism response.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact trigger rule, the response appears spontaneously and the central cause-and-effect claim is no longer demonstrated. Removed rule: "Each bounded body action visibly precedes one typography response."

invariants.rule: Short exact words remain readable and spatially attached to the triggering action.
invariants.purpose: Keeps the middle progression registered instead of allowing an unexplained reset.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact progression rule, the middle can jump to a replacement state and the accumulated result is no longer traceable. Removed rule: "Short exact words remain readable and spatially attached to the triggering action."

invariants.rule: Detail shots reconnect to the complete character before the next module.
invariants.purpose: Reconnects the changed or partial state to the established subject and spatial anchor.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact reconnection rule, detail or transformed shots can belong to a different subject or geography and continuity cannot be verified. Removed rule: "Detail shots reconnect to the complete character before the next module."

invariants.rule: The final lockup reunites character, palette, graphic motif and one exact title.
invariants.purpose: Turns the terminal hold into observable proof that the mechanism completed.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact terminal-proof rule, the sequence stops on motion alone and never confirms the promised outcome or preserved aftermath. Removed rule: "The final lockup reunites character, palette, graphic motif and one exact title."

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair with a readable role.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.

anti_copy_exclusions: all source faces, bodies, wardrobe, identities and creator-specific character designs
the source location, set dressing, props, products and exact environmental geometry
all source words, logos, watermarks, typefaces and brand identifiers
the source choreography, exact camera path, shot durations and transition timing
the source palette, signature effects, prompt wording, creator handle and narrative particulars
